title: Ruth Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Ruth 4: Boaz redeems Elimelech's land at the gate, marries Ruth, and Obed is born.

questions.text: Where did Boaz go up and sit down to meet the near kinsman?
questions.explanation: Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there, and the near kinsman came by.

questions.text: How many elders of the city did Boaz take to sit with them?
questions.explanation: Boaz took ten men of the elders of the city and said, "Sit down here."

questions.text: What did Boaz say Naomi was selling?
questions.explanation: Naomi was selling the parcel of land which was their brother Elimelech's.

answers.text: The parcel of land that was Elimelech's

questions.text: Why did the near kinsman say he could not redeem the land?
questions.explanation: He said, "I can't redeem it for myself, lest I endanger my own inheritance."

answers.text: He would endanger his own inheritance
He did not have enough silver
The elders would not allow it
He was afraid of the Moabites

questions.text: According to the old custom in Israel, what did a man do to confirm a transaction?
questions.explanation: A man took off his sandal and gave it to his neighbor; this was the way of formalizing transactions in Israel.

questions.text: Ruth the Moabitess is called the wife of whom?
questions.explanation: Boaz said, "Ruth the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, I have purchased to be my wife."

questions.text: The people and elders asked that Ruth be like which two women who built the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: They said, "May Yahweh make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which both built the house of Israel."

questions.text: The women said Ruth was better to Naomi than how many sons?
questions.explanation: The women said her daughter-in-law, who loved her, was better to her than seven sons.

questions.text: What name did the neighbor women give to Ruth's son?
questions.explanation: The women, her neighbors, gave him a name, and they named him Obed.

questions.text: In the last verse, Jesse became the father of whom?
questions.explanation: The genealogy ends: "Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David."
